notes: Big fleets no longer pull every subagent transcript through the socket, idle roots shed settled subagents after a day, the stats indexer leaves boot alone, and the stall log shows socket backpressure. On 2026-10-17 one HSSports workspace held 6,198 live subagents under 13 idle roots: every session.list shipped them all, and a parent's fleet board (useAgents) called ensureLoaded on each child, so mounting one thread streamed hundreds of transcripts to the renderer. useAgents (threads/agents.ts) now returns metas only; a row decides for itself with loadsTranscript: a fleet at or under FLEET_EAGER_LOAD (24) loads every row as before, a larger one loads only rows still working, waiting or failed, and a settled row loads when opened (AgentDetail's useSessionById). useAgentModel takes the fleet size and reads a settled row from the store without fetching (useSessionIfLoaded); AgentRow and FleetPanel pass agents.length through. The archive sweep (cold.ts archivable) keeps judging a tree whole, but a root that merely sat idle this week now sheds each settled child subtree older than DEFAULT_SUBAGENT_IDLE_DAYS (1; SweepInput.subagentIdleDays), while a root that is pinned, on screen, queued or still working keeps its board whole. registerAliaxPages no longer runs indexAll at boot (33k Claude and Codex transcript files, 60 GB, walked on the main thread); the first aliax:stats:get kicks it once per process and the page polls status as before, and the indexer yields every 20 files instead of 200. stalls.ts gains setBufferedBytes (the most unsent bytes on any client socket, `wsbuf=` on every context line; index.ts wires it to wss.clients' bufferedAmount) and recordBackpressure, which sendFrame writes once per connection when its unsent bytes pass BACKPRESSURE_BYTES (8 MB): the day's symptom was a full kernel send queue behind an idle server, invisible in the request log. Tests: agents (loadsTranscript small and large fleets), cold (settled subtree under an idle root archives after the window, held roots keep their board, a grandchild under a fresh child goes on its own, window and open/queued holds), stalls (wsbuf on the context line, the backpressure line).
